card.name: The word with after compatible
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "with" right after "compatible" in infusion or diluent compatibility statements. Also fires on a few other linking words such as "of" after "member" and "for" after "approved".

modes.label: Compatible with
modes.description: The word "with" right after "is compatible" in drug preparation and compatibility text.
modes.example: Compatibility AKYNZEO for injection is compatible<< with>> intravenous dexamethasone sodium

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A short linking word after a membership, approval or risk phrase.
modes.example: Arroyo Veterinary Hospital is proud to be accredited by the American Animal Hospital Association, a member<< of>> the Sonoma Valley Chamber of Commerce,
